summary: The shared bearer can no longer read or mutate the Passport `auth/v1` namespace, the private binding still works, and isolated D1 tests cover signing, password, identity, session, and atomic access.

evidence: `kv-service/src/worker.ts:253-267` identifies the shared and scoped bearer separately and applies `namespaceAllowed` before any KV operation.
`kv-service/src/worker.ts:297-330` rejects shared-bearer get, getMany, set, delete, list, and atomic access to exact `auth/v1` keys and ancestor list prefixes.
`tests/worker_runtime.mjs:484-556` uses isolated D1 to probe signing, password, identity, session, and future private prefixes and asserts shared-bearer 403 with zero writes.
`docs/CLOUDFLARE.md:15-21` records the scoped token and coordinated cutover for retained adapters.
